item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Iran Adds New Condition as Vance Heads to Peace Talks
item.summary: The speaker of Iran’s Parliament demanded the release of blocked Iranian assets before negotiations with the United States can begin. President Trump warned Tehran not to overplay its hand.

item.title: Lebanon: Images of a Nation Uprooted by War
item.summary: A million people in Lebanon have fled their homes as Israel clashes anew with Hezbollah. This is what their lives look now.

item.title: Iran’s South Africa Mission Trolls Trump Amid Hormuz Ceasefire
item.summary: Official social media accounts for Iranian embassies have engaged in information warfare, but the ones in Africa appear to have taken the lead on the attacks.

item.title: Iran’s Battered Leaders Emerge From War Confident — and With New Cards
item.summary: For Iran’s theocratic rulers, just surviving the U.S.-Israeli onslaught means victory. But the seeds of their next crisis may already be planted.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon Plan Talks in D.C. as War Threatens U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire Deal
item.summary: Whether Israel’s conflict with Hezbollah, the Iran-backed militant group in Lebanon, is included in the Iran cease-fire is one of the major disputes rattling the truce.

item.title: Fuel Protests Cause Transport Chaos in Ireland as Iran War Spikes Prices
item.summary: The Irish government said it had called in the army after protesters blocked highways, ports and an oil refinery, causing widespread disruption.

item.title: Vance Faces Test of His Negotiating Skills With Iran Talks
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance is leading negotiations this weekend toward an end to a war that he had opposed starting.

item.title: With Iran Setting Limits, Strait of Hormuz Remains Thorny Politically
item.summary: Even after a cease-fire, Iran is keeping a chokehold on traffic, forcing countries to cut deals that could put them at odds with the U.S.

item.title: Iran Demands Release of ‘Blocked Assets’ Before Peace Talks
item.summary: In what appeared to be a new condition, Iran’s parliament speaker said that negotiations set for Saturday in Pakistan would not go ahead unless unspecified Iranian funds were released.

item.title: Why Investing in Wind and Solar to Avoid Gas Shocks Hasn’t Added Up for Some
item.summary: Renewable energy is cheaper to run than fossil fuels, especially with war choking oil supply. But it hasn’t turned out that way for some European countries, and the reason is complex.
